text_block_list.text: Besides assessing the competition level of the race, we also need to consider how to appeal based on who performs well.

text_block_list.text: "If there's a delicate, praiseworthy type around, the teary appeal might overlap. And above all else—"

text_block_list.text:
Yes. Since I'm not running, I'll focus
on gathering intel on the Satsuki Sho instead!

Let's make sure not to schedule any races in the
